The 1997 Longtail replaced the earlier car's six-speed manual with “a six-speed sequential ‘box supplied by X-trac”, and its cockpit carried “the new sequential gearshift mechanism ... now with a much taller lever, a dimpled gear knob and exposed shift linkage”. A tall lever with exposed linkage is a driver-operated stick rather than steering-wheel paddles, and a sequential mechanism selects one gear at a time. The source does not distinguish dog-ring construction, so the broader sequential category is used.
